description.ja: ― 火 消 し の 風 “ プ リ ベ ン タ ー ・ ウ イ ン ド ” ―
description.en: - Fire Extinguishing Wind “Preventer Wind” -

description.ja: 『新機動戦記ガンダム W Endless Waltz』より、火消しの風”プリベンター・ウインド”ことゼクス・マーキスが駆るトールギスＩＩＩがリアルグレードで登場。
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam W Endless Waltz ", Tallgeese III, driven by Zechs Marquis, also known as " Preventer Wind", appears in real grade.

description.ja: フェイスや各武装を新規造形を交え、1/144では類をみない細密表現と”リアル”を追求したＲＧシリーズで商品化。
description.en: Commercialized in the RG series, which pursues a detailed expression and "realism" that is unparalleled in 1/144, with new modeling of the face and each weapon.

description.ja: ●　トールギスＩＩＩの特徴的な外装を新規造形で再現
description.en: ● Reproduce the distinctive exterior of Tallgeese III with new modeling

description.ja: ３本角を有するフェイス部、大型化した肩部など特徴的な外装を新規造形で再現。
description.en: The distinctive exterior, such as the face with three horns and the enlarged shoulders, is reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: 印象的な白と青のツートンカラーを成形色で再現。
description.en: The impressive two-tone white and blue color is reproduced with molded colors.

description.ja: 頭部
description.en: head

description.ja: 特徴的な３本角のフェイス部を新規造形で立体化。
description.en: The characteristic three-cornered face part is three-dimensional with new modeling.

description.ja: 肩部外装
description.en: shoulder exterior

description.ja: ベースキット ＲＧ トールギス から大型化した肩部外装を新規造形。
description.en: The shoulder exterior has been newly sculpted from the base Kit RG Tallgeese.

description.ja: 襟部
description.en: Collar

description.ja: くび元襟部は新規パーツを交えて再現。
description.en: The neck and collar are reproduced with new parts.

description.ja: ●　“トールギスＩＩＩ”専用の大型武装類を新規造形で再現
description.en: ● Large armaments exclusively for “Tallgeese III” are reproduced with new modeling

description.ja: 特徴的なメガキャノンやヒートロッド、シールドをＲＧならではの精密ギミックを交えて新規造形で再現。
description.en: The characteristic mega cannon, heat rod, and Seal have been recreated with new modeling, along with precision gimmicks unique to RG.

description.ja: メガキャノン
description.en: mega cannon

description.ja: 新規造形で立体化されたメガキャノンは砲身の展開ギミックを搭載。
description.en: The mega cannon, which has been made three-dimensional with new modeling, is equipped with a gun barrel expansion gimmick.

description.ja: 収納状態・展開状態の２形態を差し替えなしで再現可能。
description.en: Two forms, stored and expanded, can be reproduced without replacement.

description.ja: ヒートロッド
description.en: heat rod

description.ja: 新規造形のヒートロッドはリード線とボールジョイントで再現され、フレキシブルに可動する。
description.en: The newly shaped heat rod is reproduced with lead wires and ball joints, allowing it to move flexibly.

description.ja: シールド
description.en: Seal de

description.ja: 組み換え式でシールドへのヒートロッド格納状態を再現可能。
description.en: It is recombinant and can reproduce the storage state of the heat rod in the Seal.

description.ja: ●　１／１４４スケール「ゼクス・マーキス」フィギュアが新規造形で付属。
description.en: ● 1/144 Scale "Zechs Marquis" figure is included as a new model.

description.ja: 火消しの風“プリベンター・ウインド”こと ゼクス・マーキスのフィギュアが付属。
description.en: A figure of Zechs Marquis, also known as Preventer Wind, is included.

description.ja: ●　新規デザインのリアリスティックデカールが付属。
description.en: ● Newly designed realistic decals are included.
